policy_statement: Refund eligible for: (1) service failures with rating <=2, (2) product quality defects, (3) delivery delays >48h.
constraint: Do not promise refund unless reason matches above.

policy_statement: If refund approved: full refund. If partial fault: 50% refund or store credit. First-time customers: 20% discount on next purchase.
Any crisis review (safety, legal, health, fraud) escalates to manager within 24h.
Replies in language of review where possible. English fallback if needed.
